messages:
anya: Heads up — PR-gate smoke evals on GH Actions started failing intermittently after the quantized matrix landed. Buildkite full-evals are green. Anyone seeing shard/artifact errors?
ci-bot: gha/pr-eval-smoke • job failed • runner-3 • logs uploaded • https://ci.internal/gha/1234 :warning:
devin: Seen a couple failures this morning, can you paste the failing log snippet?
anya: here — error is reproducible on one of the matrix entries:
```
ERROR: ShardManifestNotFound: manifest for shard=42 missing in s3://eval-artifacts/pr-9876/
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/runner/bootstrap.py", line 88, in main
    download_shard(manifest_path)
  File "/runner/artifact.py", line 47, in download_shard
    raise ShardManifestNotFound(manifest_path)
```
linh: that looks like an upload/race. GH Actions `upload-artifact` sometimes returns before the eventual S3 put is fully consistent for downstream self-hosted consumers. We also saw a race with parallel matrix jobs reading the same artifact key.
sasha: also possible runner churn — we spun up more self-hosted runners last week and their ephemeral storage didn't have the layer cache. Some heavyweight steps timed out and retried, which can collide with artifact lifecycle.
mike: proposal: move heavy/IO-bound work to Buildkite (nightly / full-eval), keep quick smoke evals on GH Actions for PR gating. Add a small orchestrator: GH Actions does the smoke and uploads a "smoke-ok" marker; if marker exists then Buildkite full-eval runs via webhook/workflow_run or a label-trigger. Also add an automatic per-shard rerun: retry failed shard up to 2 times with jitter and then mark flake vs regression.
devin: sounds good. Can we implement a conservative `workflow_run` trigger for nightly coordination? Example pls.
anya: snippet we can start with (GH Actions):
```
name: pr-eval-smoke
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
jobs:
  smoke:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x86_64]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./scripts/run_smoke_eval.sh --shard 0
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: smoke-marker
          path: ./smoke_ok.txt
```
Then a separate workflow triggers Buildkite via a small POST to our BK API when `smoke-marker` exists or a label `deep-eval` is set.
linh: two more asks: (1) add `rng-seed` and `build-quant` metadata to each artifact so we can compare runs deterministically, (2) store `regression_hash` (a small digest of scored predictions) in the report to detect nondeterministic noise vs real regressions. Quantized GPU ops are slightly non-deterministic across runs.
sasha: i'll own the GH Actions changes and the upload marker flow. will open a PR today and link here. :+1:
mike: i'll do the rerun logic in the eval-runner (auto-retry with exponential backoff and a flaky-flag on second-pass success). devin, can you add the `regression_hash` to the report schema?
devin: yup — will file a tiny change to `eval-report.proto` and add tests.
anya: OK plan: (1) GH Actions smoke + marker (sasha) (2) Buildkite full eval trigger + webhook (mike) (3) runner retry + flaky labeling (mike) (4) report schema changes (devin) (5) artifact metadata for seeds (linh). Sync in 48h if PRs land. Thanks folks :eyes: :rocket:
